name: SimplePractice Note Taker
description: SimplePractice Note Taker is the native AI scribe for SimplePractice users, priced at $35/month per clinician as an add-on. As of 2026, Note Taker has expanded beyond telehealth to support in-person sessions (via mobile app), dictation, and uploaded audio. Notes flow directly into SimplePractice templates (SOAP, DAP, BIRP) with no external tool to manage. Audio is deleted immediately after transcription with 7-day transcript retention. Critical limitation: Note Taker only works inside SimplePractice—you cannot take it with you if you switch EHRs. Realistic cost: SimplePractice Essential ($79/mo) + Note Taker ($35/mo) = $114/month total.

seo.meta_description: SimplePractice Note Taker: $35/mo AI scribe add-on. Now supports in-person + telehealth. SOAP/DAP/BIRP. HITRUST certified. Locked to SimplePractice ecosystem.

faqs.q: How much does SimplePractice Note Taker cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Note Taker costs $35/month per clinician as an add-on to SimplePractice. Realistic total cost: SimplePractice Essential ($79/mo) + Note Taker ($35/mo) = $114/month. A 30-day free trial is available.

faqs.q: Does SimplePractice Note Taker work with in-person sessions?
faqs.a: Yes, as of 2026. Note Taker now supports in-person sessions via the SimplePractice mobile app, dictation, and uploaded audio—not just telehealth. However, in-person desktop recording is not supported; you must use the mobile app.

faqs.q: What note formats does SimplePractice Note Taker support?
faqs.a: Note Taker generates notes in SOAP, DAP, BIRP, and customizable progress note formats. The AI maps transcript content into whichever SimplePractice template you select for the session.

faqs.q: Is SimplePractice Note Taker HIPAA compliant?
faqs.a: Yes. Note Taker is covered under SimplePractice's BAA and is HITRUST certified. Audio is deleted immediately after transcription, and transcripts are retained for 7 days or until note-lock. Recording is opt-in per session.

faqs.q: SimplePractice Note Taker vs Mentalyc: which is better?
faqs.a: If you're committed to SimplePractice, Note Taker ($35/mo add-on) provides seamless integration. If you might switch EHRs or want modality-aware therapy notes (CBT, DBT) and Alliance Genie tracking, Mentalyc ($20-70/mo standalone) is more flexible. Both are therapy-specific.
